items.status: LOGGED — protocol rule proven unsatisfiable in this registry; rank-correlation half passes
items.title: The >70%-of-dots-within-3-px lane-drift rule cannot be satisfied by any candidate in this family
items.detail: Measured with the repository's own dot-overlap definition. (a) The incumbent h33-h33-2-b2 raster (owner-reported 0.2778) has 100.0% of its dots within 3 px of 19GEMSDOE__h19-5-powerlaw-budget-multiline.tif's dots, i.e. the rule as literally written condemns the highest-scoring published member of the family. (b) The set of footprint cells that are more than 3 px from EVERY registry dot is empty (0 of 776,915 consensus-support cells), so a compliant placement does not exist inside any registry-adjacent region. (c) The registry also contains a 311,617-cell raster (gems61-lane-buried-step-gravinversion-hgm-r3-k400k-b2zeros.tif) whose positive cells blanket the footprint, which makes the criterion degenerate for any candidate. Measured for this candidate: 0.999 against that raster, exact-cell Jaccard 0.1695 against the closest registry raster, new byte hash, dot count 32,000 absent from the registry, max |Spearman| 0.289 (limit 0.90).
items.recommended_action: Replace the dot rule with a density-matched comparison (compare against rasters of comparable dot count and comparable covered area) and a decoded-pixel Jaccard limit, and certify registry completeness before any rule is treated as a release gate.

items.title: A prior+published-metric model cannot reproduce the family's score ordering
items.detail: A 7-parameter density model (rho = g*softmax(b.z) with z in {K, step_max, distance-to-catalogue, lidar-valid, SGMC}; Poisson-approximated FPw) fitted to the 18 distinct owner-reported scores reached in-sample RMSE 0.093 and stayed anti-correlated with observation at every tested prior exponent (Spearman -0.61 to -0.86). It therefore cannot be used to design or rank emissions, and is recorded as evidence that the family's smaller, sharper dot sets score better for a reason this model does not encode.

items.detail: The 18 scores in evidence66/e1_layer_scan.json are copied from scripts/calibrate_live.py, which carries the same caveat. No hash-to-score crosswalk exists in this checkout.
